trial_court: IV Additional District and Sessions Judge, Vijayawada, Krishna District
case_name: Korraee Venkata Lakshmi Korada Rama ... vs Korraee Poorna
facts_of_case: Matrimonial disputes between spouses. Petitioner/wife seeking transfer of case due to distance.

legal_principles.principle: A party seeking transfer of a case must demonstrate that it is necessary to avoid unnecessary inconvenience.
legal_principles.held: Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the petitioner and for the reasons mentioned in the accompanying affidavit, there shall be an Interim Stay of all further proceedings including the appearance of the petitioner herein i.e., the respondent.

outcome.final_order: Interim Stay of all further proceedings till 16.06.2025

keywords: IV Additional District and Sessions Judge
Latin maxim: Nemo judex in causa sua
use_for_drafting: drafting a transfer petition for a spouse seeking to relocate
advising on the implications of filing an annulment petition
assisting with matrimonial disputes and separate residence
